title: [W]Sharing this application
p1: [W]The tribunal must treat both sides fairly. This means that each party must see or hear what other parties tell the tribunal.
p2: [W]The rules say that that you must share all communication to the tribunal with the respondent, apart from in limited circumstances.
p3: [W]The tribunal might also decide that your communication needs to be shared with some or all claimants in your group claim.
